scientific_integrity: Theorem 3.4 of Kozlov (2026) supplies the underlying nonequivariant component classification; invariant tournament enumeration and odd-order tournament automorphisms are credited to established literature. The stated equivariant character and quotient results are proved from these inputs. Finite exhaustive checks for n=3,4,5,6 independently corroborate the proof, not certify its all-parameter scope.
scientific_limitations: Only complete graphs K_n for n >= 3, natural S_n and A_n relabeling, rational graded homology characters and actual quotient homeomorphism types; no general-graph extension, integral equivariant splitting, or claim of independent verification. A mathematically equivalent unindexed published result cannot be excluded.
title: Equivariant homology and symmetry quotients of complete-graph flex complexes
